video_title: Phoenix Suns Media Day 2026 Broadcast | Part 1

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: Unidentified speaker says the Suns are focused on building a sustainable winning culture and championship foundation.
quotes.quote: Last season we talked about actually when we were here around a year ago, we talked about building a team that the city could be proud of to support the team. We talked about grit, we talked about toughness, we talked about an identity, a culture and we feel like we've done a lot of that, but at the same time we did it for one year. And so how do we continue to build upon that going forward? That type of level of care, that winning attitude, that work ethic, that drive that made us special last year and in a good position is what we have to build on. It can't just be a one year thing and so this year we're really excited to continue to build upon that going forward and continue to focus on winning and building this organization towards a championship as we've all talked about.
quotes.social_post: Unidentified speaker says the Suns are focused on building a sustainable winning culture and championship foundation. It cannot just be a one year thing.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: Unidentified speaker explains why he wanted to join the Phoenix Suns
quotes.quote: I remember playing against them and I am like this team is hard, they are hard to guard, they are connected. I have heard great things about Coach Ott. I love the way he coaches and the way that they play and when you are playing against a team like that and you are like man this team is hard to guard you you feel it and the way that they play it is like you you want to be a part of that.
quotes.social_post: Unidentified speaker says he wanted to join the Phoenix Suns because he saw how hard they were to guard and how connected they played.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: Unidentified speaker credits the front office and coaching staff for their work in player development and retention.
quotes.quote: They worked their butts off to get us better. And the way we're going to continue to win in the NBA and continue to take another step is by developing our players, keeping our team together and building. And hopefully you saw that with some of the great contracts and setups we have. The lot of guys earned great contracts and they want to be here. People want to be in Phoenix and we're excited about what we're building here.
quotes.social_post: Unidentified speaker credits the front office and coaching staff for their work in player development and retention. People want to be in Phoenix and we are excited about what we are building here.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: Unidentified speaker defines the Suns way as a unique set of standards
quotes.quote: The Suns way is just the way we do things. We do things different here. Whether we are right, wrong or indifferent, the Suns way is we have things that we believe in. How we are great teammates, what we do on and off the court, how we compete, how we a lot of different things and there is different standards that we have here in Phoenix and if you are going to be part of the team, you got to be part of doing it the Suns way.
quotes.social_post: Unidentified speaker says the Suns way is about doing things differently, holding players to high standards, and being great teammates on and off the court.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: Unidentified speaker says Steve Nash personally mentored him during his summer workouts.
quotes.quote: I was in there with Steve. Steve sat down and stayed with me during a lot of my workouts. I would do my workout, go through it and he would be there just critiquing and tell me what he saw. So it was a good feeling just for him to even stay there and actually watch my workout in general. It's a good feeling.
quotes.social_post: Unidentified speaker says Steve Nash personally mentored him during his summer workouts. It is a good feeling just for him to even stay there and actually watch my workout in general.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: Unidentified speaker explains the team's offseason roster moves
quotes.quote: We were we felt like there was an opportunity for athleticism and strength at the power forward and Miles Bridges really fits that bill. He really is a kind of guy that I think really brings that toughness, that defensive intensity but also that downhill approach from a basketball perspective. We felt like he was a good fit and then obviously adding a Co-Pete and then Luke Kennard as a shooter because we we obviously given up Grayson Allen and Rice, we love both those guys.
quotes.social_post: Unidentified speaker says Miles Bridges was added to the roster for his athleticism, strength, and defensive intensity.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: Unidentified speaker says he is adjusting well to life in Phoenix after his trade.
quotes.quote: The city has been greeting me very well. It's easier to get around than in Charlotte. But you know, the city's been great to me, my teammates have been great to me helping me get integrated into the city and everything's been good.
quotes.social_post: Unidentified speaker says he is adjusting well to life in Phoenix after his trade. The city has been great to me and my teammates have been great to me helping me get integrated into the city.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: Unidentified speaker emphasizes the importance of depth in the modern NBA
quotes.quote: I think the NBA has transformed where play hard and the grit and grind mentality is key and if you are going to do that, you got to have depth because guys get banged up and I think there is strength in our depth. So you right there is going to be incredible battles really across every single position. Everyone pushes each other and everyone pushes, rising tide lifts all boats, that will be a really good thing for us.
quotes.social_post: Unidentified speaker says depth is key in the modern NBA because players get injured and you need everyone to be ready to compete.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: Unidentified speaker reflects on his decision to return to Michigan State instead of entering the NBA draft.
quotes.quote: I just thought I wasn't ready for the NBA. My mom wanted me to leave. My dad, he really didn't care. But you know, Coach Izzo was telling me to leave, but at the time I didn't feel like I was ready, off the court and on the court to be on my own in the NBA. And I think that was the best decision I could ever make because now I'm going into my ninth year.
quotes.social_post: Unidentified speaker reflects on his decision to return to Michigan State instead of entering the NBA draft. I did not feel like I was ready off the court and on the court to be on my own in the NBA.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: Unidentified speaker believes the new roster additions will fit in well
quotes.quote: I see it gelling really well. The competitiveness is all time high. I think we want to get each other better each and every time we step on that floor. So those pieces that we got, Luke and Miles are going to gel real well with what we are doing, give us you know that more three-pointer threat and that bigger athletic jack of all trades four man that we we needed.
quotes.social_post: Unidentified speaker says the team is gelling well and the new additions will provide more three-point shooting and athleticism.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: Unidentified speaker says his primary goal is winning as many games as possible.
quotes.quote: Just win as many games as possible. That's the state of my career that I'm at. And it's my job to lead the way, lead by example, lead by voice and you know, I'm not the only leader in the group. We have a lot of guys in here that are following coach, but I have been here the longest and you know, it's my responsibility to make sure everyone's on the same page.
quotes.social_post: Unidentified speaker says his primary goal is winning as many games as possible. It is my job to lead the way, lead by example, lead by voice and make sure everyone is on the same page.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: Unidentified speaker highlights the team's improved versatility and depth
quotes.quote: I think versatility for sure. You need as many tools and toolboxes as you can get heading into each night. You have a plan but that plan often gets scrapped when you are reading the game and trying to feel it out exactly what it will take to win that game and we have got more versatile with some of our pieces. I do think the depth has been enhanced from 12 months ago.
quotes.social_post: Unidentified speaker says the team has become more versatile and has better depth than they did 12 months ago.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: Unidentified speaker says he is feeling better than ever heading into training camp.
quotes.quote: The gym time's always consistent. I think I learn new things about my body every year and different training mechanisms and you know, just just the movement around everything and you know, I think I found some things this summer. I'm feeling better than ever, the best I have at this point of the season going into training camp.
quotes.social_post: Unidentified speaker says he is feeling better than ever heading into training camp. I learn new things about my body every year and I think I found some things this summer.
